NFTKept.outcome: purchaser keeps the NFT and pays the depositor out

DepositorBidAccepted.outcome: purchaser sells back to the depositor for ETH

DepositorBidAcceptedAsTokens.outcome: purchaser sells back and takes $FWA instead of ETH -- 73.9% of all settlements

NFTRelisted.outcome: position recycled back into the pool

UnsettledFinalized.outcome: abandoned position finalized by anyone after the 7 d window
